_readme: Draft Barnwell walk. [[c:...]] = cyan, not confirmed. Positions are guesses until recorded on site.
name: Barnwell Manor

layers.essential_history: [[c:Barnwell Manor was home to the Montagu family from 1540. In 1938 Prince Henry, Duke of Gloucester, bought the house and estate.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:It is a private home: please look from the road.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:A stable boy at the manor saw Master Thorne's saddlebag left by All Saints, at the south end of the village.]]

puzzle.title: [[c:The saddlebag]]
puzzle.intro: [[c:A is 1, B is 2, C is 3, and so on.]]
puzzle.question: [[c:Where was the saddlebag left? (one word)]]
hints: [[c:All Saints has only this part left.]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:3 8 1 14 3 5 12 spells CHANCEL. The bag is in the chancel of All Saints.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:Stuck? Take a hint: hints are free.]]

evidence: [[c:Master Thorne's saddlebag was left at the chancel of All Saints.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:The countryside loop, about 4.2 km. Walk back south along Armston Road beside the brook to the Montagu Arms, then follow the road east out of the village. Keep on it as it bends south-east towards Armston, about 1.7 km. Near the bottom, take the footpath on the right heading west across the fields, about 1.6 km, back to Main Street. Turn right up Main Street to All Saints.]]
